_comment: Fungus v2 seed 7021 T4, the board of docs/design/fungus-v2-fd-diverge-7021.md (2026-10-17). The kill: Forest, Utopia Mycon, Saproling Burst; Burst's entry opens BREAKPOINT SITE 9 (post-entry activation), whose searched continuation casts Brightcap Badger AS ITS ADVENTURE Fungus Frolic ({2}{G}, two Saprolings) and pops the Burst three times -- every body hasted by Concordant Crossroads, 17 damage exactly. The executor's site-9 twin (AIEngine::TakeTurn, pe_cast) dropped the adventure flag when it cast the continuation, so it tried the {3}{G} creature, could not pay, and the two tokens never existed: the search proved T4 and the game won T5. Asserts the realised T4. Filler is a card the deck cannot cast before T5 off this board's spare mana, so the draw adds nothing.
